title: CRLR/57/2013 of JAI VEER PUNDIR Vs SMT. SHASHI PUNDIR

paras.text:
I.A. No. 1455 / 13
In
CRLR No. 57 of 2013
Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.

Ms. Pushpa Joshi, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Manoj Bisht, Advocate for
the revisionist.
 Issue notice to the respondent.
Steps be taken within a week.
 List after the notice is served upon
the respondent.
 Urgency Application No. 1455 of
2013 is allowed. Supplementary affidavit
filed by the revisionist is taken on record.
 By way of present criminal revision
the revisionist has assailed the judgment
and order dated 1st March 2013, passed by
II Addl. Sessions Judge, Haridwar, in
Criminal Appeal No. 141 of 2012, Jai
Veer Pundir vs. State and another,
whereby the learned appellate court has
dismissed the appeal filed by the
revisionist against the order dated 18th
August 2012, passed by Addl. Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, Haridwar in
Misc. Case No. 05 of 2012, Shashi vs.
Ajay Veer Pundir and others, whereby
objections of the revisionist against the
dismissal of the appeal in absence of the
complainant under Section 256(1) of
Cr.P.C. were not considered.
 Having heard learned counsel for
the revisionist, it is provided as an interim
measure that no further hearing of Misc.
Case No. 05 of 2012 shall take place till
the next date of listing.
